concerns.text: T002 requires the loader to 'fail loudly if the attached dataset's provenance does not name the origin of hardness values', but the dataset contract has no provenance/metadata field, so no task can implement or test this gate against a defined input. Add a task (or extend T001) to add a provenance block to materials_dataset.schema.yaml so the gate is verifiable.

T008's verification runs against 'fixture checkpoints', but no task explicitly produces fixture checkpoints when the study is gated — T006 does not state it saves checkpoints under outputs/. Add an explicit fixture-checkpoint production step (in T006 or T008) so the inference task has a defined input artifact.

The spec's polymorph edge case and reviewer feedback raise formula-level leakage (same formula in train and test folds); T004 covers only material-ID disjointness. Add a formula-level split-hygiene assertion/test to T004 or T011 to cover this edge case.
